title: Senators Cornyn and Tillis Force Delay of Blanche Nomination Over Trump’s IRS Deal
summary: John Cornyn and Thom Tillis accused the nominee for attorney general of refusing to put on paper his promise to kill aspects of the deal he cut to settle President Trump’s suit against the agency.
